name: Keenable
description: OpenClaw Keenable web search provider plugin.

webSearch.apiKey.label: Keenable API Key (optional)
webSearch.apiKey.help: Optional — search works keyless (rate-limited). Add a key (or KEENABLE_API_KEY env var) to raise limits. Create one at https://keenable.ai/console.

webSearch.mode.label: Keenable Search Mode
webSearch.mode.help: Keenable search mode: pro (default, higher quality) or realtime (fastest).

webSearch.baseUrl.label: Keenable Base URL
webSearch.baseUrl.help: Optional Keenable-compatible API base URL for trusted proxies. Defaults to https://api.keenable.ai.
